articles.summary: In this episode of Winning with AI, Jake Moshenko, co-founder and CEO of AuthZed, discusses the challenges of building permission systems and how SpiceDB, a cloud-native permissions system, can help software developers.
articles.title: Winning with AI podcast episode: Entrepreneurship, AI and Authzed with Jacob Moshenko

articles.summary: Explore how AuthZed's flexible authorization service can streamline user permissions management in your applications. Learn about Google's Zanzibar approach and AuthZed's implementation.
articles.title: User Permissions at Scale
